outputs.explanation: The H&E image is a micrograph/photograph, and the three adjacent panels are spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections (color-coded log2 expression per spot). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel B consists solely of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; there is no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot in which every individual patient tumor value (n=512 LUAD, n=500 LUSC) is plotted as its own point, with median and 95% CI overlaid. Scatter plots are exempt from this check since the individual points are the data itself.

Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) that overlays the individual replicate data points (n=3 per group) as colored dots on top of each bar, satisfying the requirement to show underlying individual data alongside the average.
